subject: [PATCH 2/2] mm/zswap: plug the writeback IO of an LRU walk

2026-10-07.patch_summary: This patch optimizes the writeback IO of an LRU walk in the zswap module by allowing the block layer to merge pending writes that cannot be batched together. This is achieved by plugging the LRU walk, which reduces the number of write requests and improves performance. The patch includes benchmark results showing a 6.8% reduction in write requests and a 21.6% reduction in iocost debt when running alone, and a 4.6% reduction in write requests and a 10.6% reduction in IO full pressure when running next to a sibling fio random writer.

reviews.author: Nhat Pham
reviews.summary: Nhat Pham acknowledged the patch without providing any feedback or concerns.
reviews.raw_body:
On Wed, Oct 7, 2026 at 5:37 PM Alexandre Ghiti <alex@ghiti.fr> wrote:
>
> zswap writeback only appends an entry to the pending bio when its slot
> directly follows the previous one, and submits the pending bio
> otherwise.
>
> Plug the LRU walk so that the block layer can merge what the batch
> cannot.
>
> Kernel build (defconfig, -j4) in a 600M memory.max cgroup with the zswap
> shrinker enabled, swapping to an NVMe partition with iocost enabled. It
> runs alone, and next to a sibling fio random writer with 10 times its
> io.weight so that iocost throttles it. Mean +- stddev, counters from the
> build's cgroup:
>
> Alone:
>
>                                 unplugged       plugged
>   build time (s)                1061 +- 2     1057 +- 2   -0.4%
>   write requests (k)            622 +- 34     579 +- 21   -6.8%
>   pages per write request    1.30 +- 0.02  1.36 +- 0.05   +4.9%
>   iocost debt (s)             14.0 +- 2.5   11.0 +- 1.7   -21.6%
>   iocost wait (s)              7.7 +- 1.8    7.1 +- 1.1   -7.9%
>   IO full pressure (s)        18.3 +- 1.4   17.5 +- 1.3   -4.5%
>
> Next to the writer:
>
>                                 unplugged       plugged
>   build time (s)               2188 +- 45    2104 +- 75   -3.8%
>   write requests (k)            594 +- 21     567 +- 24   -4.6%
>   pages per write request    1.30 +- 0.01  1.35 +- 0.02   +3.6%
>   iocost debt (s)               648 +- 22     645 +- 29   -0.5%
>   iocost wait (s)               624 +- 23     633 +- 29   +1.5%
>   IO full pressure (s)          615 +- 31     550 +- 44   -10.6%
>
> Signed-off-by: Alexandre Ghiti <alex@ghiti.fr>

Acked-by: Nhat Pham <nphamcs@gmail.com>

2026-10-09.patch_summary: This patch series aims to improve the performance of zswap by plugging the writeback IO of an LRU walk, allowing the block layer to merge what the batch cannot. The author has provided benchmark results showing a significant reduction in write requests and iocost debt when the patch is applied.
